record.original_question: Are these two kerGV ’s trivial or not?

evidence.quote: Question 9.11. Are these two kerGV ’s trivial or not?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\overline{\Gamma}_1^{r}$ denote Haefliger's groupoid of germs of orientation-preserving local $C^{r}$-diffeomorphisms of $\mathbb{R}$ (with the topology that trivialises the normal bundle), for $r=\infty$ (smooth) and $r=\omega$ (real analytic). Let $B\overline{\Gamma}_1^{r}$ be its classifying space. The Godbillon–Vey class defines a homomorphism
$$
\mathrm{GV}\colon H_{3}\bigl(B\overline{\Gamma}_1^{r};\mathbb{Z}\bigr)\longrightarrow \mathbb{R},
$$
whose kernel we denote by $\ker\mathrm{GV}^{r}\subset H_{3}(B\overline{\Gamma}_1^{r};\mathbb{Z})$.

Determine whether the kernels $\ker\mathrm{GV}^{\infty}$ and $\ker\mathrm{GV}^{\omega}$ are trivial. Equivalently, decide, for each of $r\in\{\infty,\omega\}$, whether every codimension-one Haefliger $C^{r}$-structure of class in $H_{3}(B\overline{\Gamma}_1^{r};\mathbb{Z})$ with vanishing Godbillon–Vey invariant is itself null-homologous.
artifact.status_search_result: The question appears in a 2025 problem list compiled from the CIRM 2024 conference on Foliations and Diffeomorphism Groups, where it is posed as an open question. No subsequent literature was found resolving the triviality of the kernel of the Godbillon–Vey homomorphism on $H_3(B\overline{\Gamma}_1^{\infty})$ or $H_3(B\overline{\Gamma}_1^{\omega})$; both remain longstanding open problems in foliation theory.

status_evidence.title: Dynamics and the Godbillon-Vey Classes: A History and Survey (Hurder)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Godbillon-Vey classes; the surjectivity and kernel of the GV homomorphism on H_3(B\bar Gamma_1) remain among the central open problems.
status_evidence.claim: The structure of the GV homomorphism on H_3 of Haefliger's classifying space is documented as open.
